definitions: A joining or merging of different parts or qualities in which the component elements are individually distinguishable though integrated.
A sequence of numbers or letters used to open a combination lock.
A set of people or things that are grouped together or considered as a unit.
The process of combining or the state of being combined.
examples: A combination of factors led to the decision.
She forgot the combination to the safe.
The team is a winning combination.
The combination of ingredients created a unique flavour.
